description: Look up an organisation donor in the Inaugural Donors Register by name substring, matched against the reviewed public name and every name as filed on the committees' Form 13 reports, optionally for one inaugural year (2025 or 2021; both when omitted, never added across years). Returns up to 5 named organisation donors, each with its reviewed type and, by year, donations accepted, refunded and net (each labelled), every donation row with its date, amount, memo and filing as filed, refunds kept apart (the filing gives no reason for any refund) and the latest filing date. For 2025 donors: the organisation's own LD-203 figure where an item was found and matched, with both amounts and, where they differ, the line that neither record explains the difference; and, for the donors in the register's side-by-side table, three more federal records beside the donation: contract obligations by fiscal year under reviewed parent records (USAspending), the connected PAC's status and its contributions to federal candidates' committees by cycle with its all-committees summary line, two measures never added (FEC), and 2025 lobbying report counts and amounts (LDA). Inaugural donations, contract obligations, connected-PAC contributions and lobbying reports are separate federal records, shown side by side and never added or put in sequence. A missing PAC, contract or lobbying record is a search result, not a fact about the organisation. Committees are named exactly as the FEC lists them, with their ids. Every answer carries the register's question note: the records describe donations reported to the FEC; they do not show what any donor received or intended, and they do not show cause and effect. Individual donors are counted, never named; withheld organisations (personal trusts, holding vehicles, businesses named for a person, names resting on initials) appear only as counts and amounts. A name that matches only a withheld string answers exactly like a name that matches nothing. Every answer quotes the FEC's restriction on the sale or use of individual contributor information (52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)).

name.description: Required case-insensitive organisation name substring, at most 80 characters; searched among named organisation donors only.

year.description: Optional inaugural year, 2025 (Trump Vance Inaugural Committee) or 2021 (PIC 2021); both when omitted, never added.
